Students must complete any two of the lower-division political science courses from American Politics, Comparative Politics, Political Theory, International Relations, listed below in order to declare the major. One of the courses should be in the students' intended subfield of specialization. The “Additional Political Science Requirement” and “History” requirements do not have to be completed before transferring and are not needed to be eligible to declare the major . All courses must be taken for a letter grade. AP TEST CREDIT AP credit cannot be used to satisfy any major requirements. More information about the Political Science major can be found by clicking on "Undergraduate Program" at http://www.polisci.berkeley.edu . Upper-division political science courses are impacted, and restricted to declared majors. Declaring the major as early as possible will better ensure that students can graduate on time.
